emails.body:
Hey Mark, 
Im following up from the board meeting discussing AI. I agree that we need to make sure to stay on top of a tech like this. I am working now to set up times to meet with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google to discuss what their platforms offer and which best suits our needs. 
Best,
CTO
emails.subject: Enterprise Ai Selection Kickoff

emails.body:
Mark, 
I have set up meetings with each company and were able to book them all this upcoming week. Anthropic will be {!Anthropic_Meet = next:TUE} on Zoom followed by Google giving us a tour of their Gemini model at {!Google_Meet = next:TUE} also over Zoom. OpenAI is sending their sales down to our office to give us an in person demonstration of ChatGPT {!OPENAI = next:WED}. I am excited that we were able to book all 3 on such short notice and look forward to seeing you there
emails.subject: AI Meeting Schedule

emails.body:
Mark, 

After our meeting today I was impressed by both software. I wrote down some notes from each and specifically like Anthropic's "CoWork" and "Code" features. I think it would totally increase speed of work while also making the work easier. I think the technical side too will enjoy Code because it speeds up their work. I would like you to send over the notes you have too in addition, I would like to see your rubric filled out by {serve+1d}. That way we can keep things rolling while staying on the same page.
emails.subject: Anthropic + Google Review

emails.body: WOW lol. Was it just me or did you feel like that entire meeting was sloppy? Im surprised such a big company would send people that barely know the product.
emails.subject: OpenAI meeting

emails.body:
Mark, 

This week is busy but while it is still fresh in our heads lets meet {!Review_Meeting = this:FRI}. Not sure what time works yet but I will email you closer to Friday.
emails.subject: Final Meeting Review

emails.body: Let's meet {next:FRI}. Im packed the rest of the day.
emails.subject: Fridays Meeting Time

emails.body:
Mark,

I have drafted up the documents to sign our deal with Anthropic. We have agreed on terms of 1Y/120k for full access employee accounts.  Please sign the formal docs by {this:SUN}.

Thank you,
CFO
emails.subject: Ai Selection Finalization
